transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. I'm here to help you. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Honestly, I'm here because I keep losing important things like my keys, my wallet, and my phone all the time. It's getting really frustrating and is starting to seriously mess up my daily routine.
Do you often find yourself feeling restless, like you have an internal motor that won't turn off, or do you frequently interrupt others when they are speaking?

Yes, definitely. I constantly feel restless and 'on the go', almost like I have an internal motor that just won't turn off. I also tend to talk excessively because of all that energy, though I try my best not to interrupt people.

latest_inference.note: The patient reports both significant inattentive symptoms (losing items) and hyperactive symptoms (internal motor, feeling 'on the go', excessive talking). Since both domains are present, the Combined Presentation is the most accurate diagnosis, narrowing the candidates down from the previous list.
